install.has_code: Note: this mod ships exefs code (subsdk, main.npdm…). The merger only uses romfs and .ips/.pchtxt patches: that code is ignored. A mod can ship a Skyline plugin (plugin.nro) instead, which is loaded.

settings.merge_at_boot: Merge when the game starts if needed
settings.merge_at_boot_hint: Off: when mods changed without being applied, the game keeps the last merge and starts fast.
settings.locales_auto_unknown: Auto (all until the game starts again)
settings.locales_hint: Auto: only the language the game uses is merged (the plugin records it at launch), which cuts the merge time of mods that change texts.
settings.layeredfs_warning: An atmosphere/contents/0100F2C0115B6000/romfs folder exists: it slows the game's start, mods belong in sd:/totk/mods.
settings.mode_hint: Started from the game's icon while holding R, the manager can apply mods itself and has all the memory.
settings.clear_cache_hint: Every kept merge (sd:/totk/merged), the changelogs (cache) and the downloads
settings.clear_cache_confirm: Delete the merge and the cache? Mods and profiles are kept.
settings.save_failed: The setting could not be saved: {}
settings.warn_conflicts_hint: When off, merges go ahead without asking; conflicts stay listed on each mod's page ().
settings.language_restart: The language changes the next time the manager starts. Restart now?
settings.restart_manually: Start the manager again from the homebrew menu to change the language.
settings.cache_hint: Going back to mods merged before (another profile, a mod turned on again) serves the kept merge instead of merging again. A file identical from one merge to another is written once. Beyond the chosen number, the least recently used merges are deleted at the next merge.
settings.boost_hint: Standard: the mode games use while loading. Maximum: on top of that, when sys-clk is installed, the CPU and the memory run at the frequencies below during the merge, then sys-clk goes back to its settings. Memory matters a lot: 1600 MHz instead of 1331 in handheld mode makes merging much faster.
settings.sysclk_missing: sys-clk is not running: Maximum works like Standard. With sys-clk, it sets the memory clock too.
settings.sysclk_old: This sys-clk (API {}) does not list its frequencies: the manager asks it for {} MHz for the CPU and {} MHz for the memory, which it rounds.
settings.sysclk_hint: Stock maximums: 1785 MHz for the CPU, 1600 MHz for the memory. Higher values only show with an overclocking sys-clk or Atmosphère, at your own risk.
settings.mod_plugins_hint: A mod can hold a plugin.nro, loaded in the game once the merge is served: that is how several code mods coexist. Turn it off if a mod makes the game crash.

conflicts.title: {} conflict(s) between mods
conflicts.rule: For each conflict, only the version of the highest mod in the list is used. To choose, change the order ( in the Mods tab) or disable a mod. Details:  on a mod.
